decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker presents 'manual saving' with page-detail collection omitted. Round 1 client: 'I'd have to type in a title myself, and that grabbing the page's details automatically is left out. That's not what I want — when I paste a link, I expect it to go fetch the page's title, its little icon, and ideally a short description or preview... I'd still want to be able to tweak that title or description before and after saving.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Draft diverges from REF-BM-02 (auto-collect title/description/favicon/preview) by requiring manual entry; client rejects the manual behaviour and supplies the auto-fetch-then-edit behaviour, also covering REF-BM-03 (edit before/after).

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: '...duplicate warnings.' Round 1 client: 'You've got it warning me and letting me keep both copies. Honestly I don't want two copies — if I save a link I already saved, I'd expect it to just take me to the existing one so I can update it. Preventing duplicates matters more to me than being allowed to keep them.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Draft (warn + keep both copies) contradicts REF-BM-06 (converge to editing the existing bookmark). Client supplies the reference-conforming convergence behaviour.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker scope enumerates saving/notes/tags/search/filter/sort/edit/delete only. Round 1 client: 'mark a bookmark as unread and then have a way to look at just my unread ones, and mark them read once I'm done.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Read-later/unread requirement absent from presented scope; client requests the missing reference requirement (REF-BM-17 mark unread, REF-BM-18 view unread separately, REF-BM-19 mark read).

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker offers deletion only. Round 1 client: 'Delete should be permanent, yes. But I also want to be able to tuck a bookmark away — get it out of my main list without losing it — and pull up an "archived" list later. Right now there's only delete.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Archive missing from presented scope; client requests it distinct from delete (REF-BM-26 hide/keep, REF-BM-27 reversible vs permanent, REF-BM-28 archived list).

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'notes' (plain). Round 1 client: 'Plain text is a little thin. I'd like my notes to support simple formatting (headings, lists, links) and show up nicely formatted when I read them.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Presented plain-text note behaviour diverges from REF-BM-23 (markdown note rendered on view); client supplies the formatted-note behaviour.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker presents basic 'search'. Round 1 client: 'Case-insensitive search is good. But I'd also want to search by tag with a shorthand, combine conditions (this AND that, one OR another, excluding something), and search an exact phrase in quotes.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Draft search lacks tag shorthand/boolean/phrase; client requests the missing reference search requirements (REF-BM-14 #tag, REF-BM-15 AND/OR/NOT groups, REF-BM-16 quoted phrase). REF-BM-13 case-insensitive was already present.

decisions.evidence: Absent from round 1 maker scope. Round 1 client: 'select several bookmarks and do one action to all of them — tag them, mark read/unread, archive, or delete — including everything currently matching my search or filter.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Bulk actions missing; client requests REF-BM-20 (multi-select bulk action) and REF-BM-21 (apply to whole filtered collection).

decisions.evidence: Absent from round 1 maker scope. Round 1 client: 'If I've set up a search with certain tags included and others excluded, I'd like to save that combination and reuse it later.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Saved-search/bundle requirement missing; client requests REF-BM-29 (save search term + included/excluded tags for reuse).

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: '...import/export are excluded for now.' Round 1 client: 'I'd want to import them from the standard bookmarks file and be able to export mine back out too. Leaving that out would be a real gap for me.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Import/export explicitly excluded, contradicting REF-BM-30 (Netscape HTML import) and REF-BM-31 (export); client requests the omitted reference requirements back into scope.

decisions.evidence: Absent from round 1 maker scope. Round 1 client: 'Being able to set my default sort order, how many items show, and text size would make it feel like mine.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Display/personal settings missing; client requests REF-BM-32 (default sort, displayed items, font size).

decisions.evidence: Round 5 maker presents the delivered app (features listed; no snapshot/page-preservation). Round 5 client: 'I do have a couple of ideas for down the road (like keeping a saved copy of a page in case it disappears), but those are new wishes for a later round, not anything missing from what we agreed.'
decisions.note: Implementation review. Snapshot/local-page preservation (REF-BM-24) was never presented across spec/plan/tasks/app and is absent from the reference-required feature set. The client explicitly names the expectation ('keeping a saved copy of a page in case it disappears') and identifies it as absent, but accepts the departure as future work — expressed acceptance, catch_type=none.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'saving... links'. Round 1 client: 'A lot of it matches what I pictured: saving links...'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Presented save-by-url conforms to REF-BM-01; recorded conforming decision, not an opportunity.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'editing'. Round 1 client affirms '...editing, deleting.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Presented edit capability conforms to REF-BM-04.
Specification gate. Presented deletion conforms to REF-BM-05.
Specification gate. Tag assignment conforms to REF-BM-09.
Specification gate. Tag filtering conforms to REF-BM-11.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'search'. Round 1 client: 'Case-insensitive search is good.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Presented full-text, case-insensitive search conforms to REF-BM-12/REF-BM-13; the operator/tag/phrase extensions are handled as a separate divergent decision.
Specification gate. Sort-by-key conforms to REF-BM-22.
